entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:1
segments: ¶I [am] the rose of Sharon, [And] the lily of the valleys.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:2
segments: THE BELOVED Like a lily among thorns, So is my love among the daughters.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:3
segments: ¶THE SHULAMITE Like an apple tree among the trees of the woods, So [is] my beloved among the sons. I sat down in his shade with great delight, And his fruit [was] sweet to my taste.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:4
segments: THE SHULAMITE TO THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM He brought me to the banqueting house, And his banner over me [was] love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:5
segments: Sustain me with cakes of raisins, Refresh me with apples, For I [am] lovesick.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:6
segments: His left hand [is] under my head, And his right hand embraces me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:7
segments: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles or by the does of the field, Do not stir up nor awaken love Until it pleases.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:8
segments: ¶THE SHULAMITE The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes Leaping upon the mountains, Skipping upon the hills.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:9
segments: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Behold, he stands behind our wall; He is looking through the windows, Gazing through the lattice.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:10
segments: My beloved spoke, and said to me: "Rise up, my love, my fair one, And come away.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:11
segments: For lo, the winter is past, The rain is over [and] gone.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:12
segments: The flowers appear on the earth; The time of singing has come, And the voice of the turtledove Is heard in our land.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:13
segments: The fig tree puts forth her green figs, And the vines [with] the tender grapes Give a good smell. Rise up, my love, my fair one, And come away!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:14
segments: ¶"O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, In the secret [places] of the cliff, Let me see your face, Let me hear your voice; For your voice [is] sweet, And your face [is] lovely."

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:15
segments: HER BROTHERS Catch us the foxes, The little foxes that spoil the vines, For our vines [have] tender grapes.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:16
segments: THE SHULAMITE My beloved [is] mine, and I [am] his. He feeds [his flock] among the lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:17
segments: (TO HER BELOVED) Until the day breaks And the shadows flee away, Turn, my beloved, And be like a gazelle Or a young stag Upon the mountains of Bether.
